card.name: Digits inside numbers and name endings
card.fires_on: Mostly a single digit partway through a decimal or multi-digit number, such as the 2 in 2.2 or the 9 in 59°F. Also seen on a few name endings and single letters in abbreviations.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a decimal or longer number in tables, doses, temperatures or frequencies.

modes.label: Name or abbreviation piece
modes.description: The ending of a surname in a citation or the first letter of an abbreviation.

card.writes: Promotes math-function starts like sin, lim and log, and suppresses unrelated pieces, so it hints at no clear next word.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, so the number is not yet finished.
